title: HTTP API & Cell Host Surface
summary: All OpenAPI v1 HTTP routes served by norn-api / norn-cell hosts: provisioning, governed definitions, objects, actions, runs, decisions, inbox, questions, transforms, datasets, privacy guard, and MCP.

features.title: Action invocation and multi-step flow runs API

probe.drive: Against a running `norn dev` cell (bearer token from `.norn/dev.json`), call `GET /v1/actions`, invoke an admitted action via `POST /v1/actions/{actionId}` with an `Idempotency-Key`, and start/inspect a flow via `POST /v1/runs` + `GET /v1/runs/{id}`.
probe.observableEndState: `GET /v1/actions` lists admitted actions with schemas; `POST /v1/actions/{actionId}` returns receipt/pending/refused envelope; `GET /v1/runs/{id}` reflects durable run state.
gotchas: Mutating action calls require an explicit non-blank idempotency key and matching org/env scope headers.

features.title: Cell provisioning and governed definition plan/apply/install API

probe.drive: Target a provisioned hosted cell / Rivet instance (or run the hosted tenant integration suite `crates/norn-cell-do/tests/hosted_install.rs` in CI or a Boat sandbox) for `POST /v1/cell:provision`, `POST /v1/cell/definitions:plan`, `POST /v1/cell/definitions:apply` (with `expectedVersion`), `POST /v1/definitions:install`, and `POST /v1/definitions/{id}:retire`; read back via `GET /v1/definitions?orgId=<orgId>&environmentId=<environmentId>`, `GET /v1/definitions:list`, and `GET /v1/definitions/{id}` (read and `:admit` routes are also served on `norn dev`).
probe.observableEndState: On a hosted cell, plan reports exact diff without mutating cell state, apply advances definition revision atomically via CAS on `expectedVersion`, and catalog endpoints return the newly active definitions with matching digest; on `norn dev`, definition-mutating routes fail closed with `409 defs.dev_sources_only`.
gotchas: `norn dev` intentionally rejects `POST /v1/cell/definitions:plan`, `POST /v1/cell/definitions:apply`, `POST /v1/definitions:install`, and `POST /v1/definitions/{id}:retire` with `409 defs.dev_sources_only` (`DEV-ONE-AUTHORITY-1` in `crates/norn-cell-do/src/dev/http.rs`); never target `norn dev` to prove hosted plan/apply.
Applying against a stale `expectedVersion` or as a non-admin/non-owner principal must fail closed.

features.title: Human approvals, decision queue, and inbox API

probe.drive: Trigger an approval-gated action as developer, inspect `GET /v1/decisions:requested` and `GET /v1/inbox`, attempt self-approval (must refuse), then approve via `POST /v1/decisions/{id}:decide` using the reviewer token from `.norn/dev.json` and confirm via `GET /v1/decisions`.
probe.observableEndState: Self-approval fails closed; reviewer decision commits atomically, resolves the pending decision in `GET /v1/decisions`, and applies the fenced action effect.
gotchas: The requester principal can never decide their own pending approval; always read `reviewer.tokenFile` from `.norn/dev.json`.

probe.drive: Send a JSON-RPC 2.0 `tools/list` request to `POST /v1/mcp` on a running `norn dev` cell with bearer auth and scope headers, then invoke a returned tool via `tools/call`.
probe.observableEndState: `tools/list` returns the cell's live admitted tools with JSON Schemas and catalog digest; `tools/call` routes through the same cell authority and returns a receipt or typed refusal.
gotchas: Discovery never installs definitions; unauthenticated or out-of-scope MCP calls refuse closed.

features.title: Object query, detail, facets, profile, links, lineage, history, quarantine, and export API

probe.drive: Create or load objects in a local `norn dev` cell, then query `GET /v1/objects/{type}`, `GET /v1/objects/{type}/{id}`, `/links`, `/lineage`, `/history`, `/findings`, `:facets`, `:profile`, `:quarantined`, and `:export`.
probe.observableEndState: All read routes enforce caller scope/markings, return exact canonical fields and deterministic pagination, and surface quarantined findings with provenance.
gotchas: Unauthorized object reads or unknown types must return typed refusals rather than empty success lists.

features.title: Marked property reveal and LLM privacy guard prompt/restore API

probe.drive: On a cell with marked PII properties, confirm default object reads redact marked fields, call `POST /v1/objects/{type}/{id}/reveal` with an authorized role (and verify denial without it), then run `POST /v1/guard:prompt` followed by `POST /v1/guard/{id}:restore`.
probe.observableEndState: Marked values stay redacted on standard reads; authorized reveal records audit receipt; guard pseudonymizes prompt text and restores original tokens only for the matching session/scope.
gotchas: Never log revealed secrets or unredacted prompt bodies into verification evidence artifacts.

features.title: Questions, metrics catalog, evaluation, and numeric trace API

probe.drive: Query `GET /v1/questions:catalog` and `GET /v1/questions:metrics` on a `norn dev` cell, fetch `GET /v1/questions/{question}/answer` and `/trace`, and execute an ad-hoc `POST /v1/questions:evaluate` + `POST /v1/questions:trace`.
probe.observableEndState: Answers return exact decimal values, frontier/revision pins, and contribution trace rows matching the underlying authorized object snapshot.
gotchas: As-of-knowledge and as-of-effective cutoffs must agree on canonical totals at the same revision frontier.

features.title: Declarative transforms, dataset loads, and row lineage API

probe.drive: Load dataset rows via `POST /v1/datasets:load`, compile/inspect a transform via `POST /v1/transforms:compile` and `GET /v1/transforms/{transform}/plan`, refresh via `POST /v1/transforms/{transform}:refresh`, and read `GET /v1/transforms/{transform}/rows` plus both dataset and transform row `:lineage` endpoints.
probe.observableEndState: Transform rows materialize deterministically over the authorized snapshot and every row lineage response traces back to exact contributing source rows and revisions.
gotchas: Optional DuckDB/DataFusion analytical backends must match the exact cell evaluator over the same snapshot.
